rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Floribunda.
Registration name: POUlkaro
Exhibition name: Karoo Rose
rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, 1988). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, 1988).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S as 'Karoo Rose'.
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses as 'Karoo Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Orange or orange-red, ages to deep pink . Flowers orange-red, aging watermelon-pink. None to mild fragrance. 32 petals. Medium, full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, in large clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Medium, dense, well-branched. Medium, medium green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Very hardy.
rows.Notes: The most arid part of South Africa is called the Karoo.
